matches.rationale: GT1 describes contradictions in equations (2)-(5) including ambiguous residual label definitions that risk negative values and incompatible shapes. Pred_id 2 directly detects this by proving that the residual label formula in equation (2) can produce negative values (-1 in the counterexample), contradicting the paper's claim that masking ensures non-negativity. This is the same defect in the same equation.

pred_verdicts.rationale: Identifies a genuine mathematical error in Lemma 1's proof (Appendix A) that is not listed in the ground truth.
Detects GT1 by proving the residual label formula can produce negative values despite the masking claim.
Reports proof errors in Lemma 1 (constant inconsistencies, unstated assumptions) not covered by the ground truth.
